method: Equal-weighted chained daily returns of each sector's current constituents; a day chains only when >= 3 constituents contribute a valid return; returns spanning > 20 calendar days or beyond the +/-10% circuit band (+/-10.5% guard) are excluded as suspension / corporate-action reference resets. Base 1000. Established history is append-only: later runs extend it, never rewrite it. Trading is a two-stock sector (BBC, STC); its days chain when both constituents contribute.
